comparison: 13/15 executed PASS vs v7 14/16; confirms 0-NS Smooth Sign-MP critic passes grid100_mlp16 (0.9926/0.0631) and pre_shift_hq (0.9219) on saddle shift, while D-Frob-MP (v7) is faster on small MLPs and cleaner on ddgan/saddle mass_tv.
conclusion: law4-energy-v9 (Law 4.4 Asymmetric 0-NS Critic Smooth Sign-MP + 5-step 2D Polar G) scored 13/16 PASS (1 INCOMPLETE wall-time timeout on five_word_joint_smoke at 900.3s under 4-way GPU contention) on r4-occam-ablation-v1, PASSing grid100_mlp16 (prec=0.9926, ctr=0.0631), grid100 (0.9917/0.0979), vector_unequal_width (0.9983/0.2557), both >548x Nash tasks, ring16 (0.9822), gaussian1d_stability, zero_tanh_rail_escape, img_bars4, and t3_iso_scale_mass_8x. Missed model_ddgan_gaussian_chain (t1_q0_eig_max=1.4623) and t3_iso_horizon_saddle_shift (pre_shift_hq=0.9219 PASS, mass_tv=0.125 vs 0.10).
